summary: TotalEnergies SE filed a Form 6-K reporting a binding agreement with Masdar to form a $2.2 billion 50/50 joint venture merging onshore renewable activities in nine Asian countries. Each partner contributes assets of comparable value, totaling 3 GW operational and 6 GW in advanced development. The joint venture will serve as the sole vehicle for solar, wind, and battery storage projects in the region. No price per share, premium, or board advisors are specified. The transaction is subject to closing conditions. Watch for regulatory approvals and execution of asset contributions.
